content:
One of my favorite Apple TV 4K features—the screensaver—could finally get audio, starting with tvOS 27, according to the latest leak. Here are the details.

tvOS 27 code reveals at least one Apple TV screensaver will get an audio option, with more expected

October is shaping up to be a huge month for Apple, with a flood of new hardware and software products hitting the market.

Among them is reportedly a brand-new Apple TV 4K, which appeared earlier today via a leaked image in Apple code.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just dropped evidence found in tvOS 27 code that at least one Apple TV screensaver will be getting audio support.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to turn the audio on or off, or use a "reduced" setting.

Using the Snoopy screensaver as an example, it doesn't look like it should be too distracting, but I'm glad Apple plans to let users turn the audio off entirely.

Although pdfu hasn't found audio support in other screensavers yet, Apple will most likely expand the feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Share your thoughts in the comments section.
